result.scope: Synthetic recharge protocol; no real account, order, or payment

assertions.name: official configuration preserves currency units and benefit semantics
manual yuan input is exact and limited to authoritative options
malformed and ambiguous configuration is rejected
option fingerprints bind benefits and text without binding retrieval time
raw decimal identifiers survive JSON without touching strings or amounts
both payment apps use one official QR order with an exact large identifier
changed terms or removed amounts stop before creating an order
order creation never retries uncertain transport results
untrusted QR URLs retain the order ID but do not expose a payment code
a received QR receipt survives optional cookie persistence errors
history preserves exact IDs and does not invent currency units or status
malformed history identifiers and list wrappers are rejected
